content: BIBREF12 provides one of the earliest works investigating the ability of RNNs to capture properties of language necessary for generalization. Further work explored how RNNs can learn context free languages BIBREF13 , BIBREF9 as well some context sensitive languages BIBREF14 . Recent work has moved outside the formal language space, with experiments that indicate RNNs may capture the hierarchical structure of natural language syntax, despite not having any hierarchical bias built in the model or the data BIBREF5 , BIBREF15 .
